## 10:00 daily run (Decider, 10:2x ET)
Inputs: technical.md, fundamentals.md, sentiment.md, risk.md, flow_gamma.md (all five in by 10:17 ET). Risk-off tape: INTC -29% on its guide, SMH about -5.5%, QQQ about -2.7% (about 696, 4% below its 50-day), SPY about 759.4 (below its 50-day), VIX about 18.9. Sizing normal (VIX < 25).

**Exits first**
- **TSM 12/18 440/450C: HOLD, stop not confirmed.** Valid marks today: Risk 10:10 liq 2.15 (at the stop) and Sentiment 10:10:54 2.15; then Decider 10:10:56 2.40, Technical 10:12 2.45, Flow & Gamma 10:11-10:12 2.35 x2, Sentiment 10:14 2.30, Decider 10:17:18 **2.40** (440C 12.30/12.85, 450C 9.35/9.90, mid 2.95, TSM 413.10). No two consecutive valid marks at or below 2.15, so stop_watch is 0/2. TSM about 413 is 13 above the close-below-400 exit. No adds (Risk veto). The stop will not be widened. Exit on the next 2 consecutive valid marks at or below 2.15, or a TSM close below 400.
- Gamma check (2026-10-30 10:12 ET, gex.py today, from Flow & Gamma): TSM 12/18 440/450C. NEGATIVE gamma, spot 414.8-415.4 below the 421.7-422.6 flip (dealers amplify moves; momentum can carry). King node 415 (10/30 0DTE, -58M to -82M) = put wall 415 = spot; nearest -420 above, -415 at spot, +440 above; no + node below. Call wall 450 = short strike = target ceiling; $5.00 needs TSM back above about 440. Put wall 415 is the only support and is breaking (TSM 413.1 at 10:17); Bullflow's put wall/king at 400 = our close-below-400 exit. VEX +$16.4M: IV relief helps, an IV spike adds selling. If 415 fails, Flow & Gamma expects the stop to confirm near TSM 411-412. HOLD pending a confirmed stop.

**New entries: none.**
- QQQ 700/690P: only qualifies on a CLOSE below 698 (QQQ about 696 intraday). Natural about 4.00-4.15 is below 2:1 (Technical says 1.41:1). Re-price Monday if today closes below 698.
- GOOGL 12/18 270/260P: Sentiment only (conditional on a 15-minute hold below 279); Fundamentals is watch-only 2/5. One analyst, fails the two-analyst rule.
- XLE: Fundamentals only, 3/5, not in today's gex data. One analyst; watch for Monday.
- TSLA (lost 400, close below 386 kills it), AAPL (earnings 11/2, long vetoed), META puts (1.60:1), LMT (about 5% above its zone): no.
- No bullish semis while TSM is open; no new premium into the weekend and the 11/3 election without a second analyst.

**Account:** about $9,810 marked (cash $9,570 + TSM 2.40 liq), peak $10,025, drawdown 2.1%, 1 of 10 positions, $0 of $1,468 weekly option budget used.

- Whale check (13:38-14:18Z): no new specific prints from the five accounts; BullflowIO repeats SPY 760/765 levels. Nothing to consider.

gamma.convention: Dealer GEX approximation: call GEX = +gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01, put GEX = -gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01 ($ of delta hedging per 1% move; assumes dealers long calls / short puts, the common public convention). Positive total = dealers dampen moves (pinning); negative = dealers amplify moves.
gamma.disclaimer: Free public data; estimate only; supporting signal for PAPER trading; never places orders.
